# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Part A Module 1, Western European Anti-Roman League & Atlantic Order (1450-1750, oe_weu_, slot 61). Generated by gen_western_europe.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope (Roman host). Dynamically compute Anti-Roman Holy League cohesion (0..100) and global_var:oe_weu_league_level (0..3).
# Zero redundant IO creation and zero any_country iteration: O(1) deterministic checks for v8.5 AI & entropy readers.
oe_weu_recalc_league = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_weu_league_threshold_met = yes
            oe_weu_western_powers_exist = yes
        }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = 25 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_rr_count
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rr_count } var:oe_rr_count >= 5 }
            }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = 20 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_weu_holds_gaul_or_iberia = yes }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = 25 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { owns = location:milano }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = 15 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_weu_fra_ruptured
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fra_ruptured } global_var:oe_weu_fra_ruptured = 1 }
            }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = 15 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_itw_influence
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_itw_influence } global_var:oe_itw_influence >= 3 }
            }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = 10 }
        }
        # Transparent player diplomatic wedges (0 black-box penalties)
        if = {
            limit = { oe_weu_fra_pact_active = yes }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = -25 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_weu_eng_treaty
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_eng_treaty } global_var:oe_weu_eng_treaty = 1 }
            }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = -15 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_weu_rel_detente
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_rel_detente } global_var:oe_weu_rel_detente = 1 }
            }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = -15 }
            if = {
                limit = { oe_weu_ecc_bridge_ready = yes }
                change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = -10 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_diplomatic_wedge_mod }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = -10 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_weu_lowlands_pact
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_lowlands_pact } global_var:oe_weu_lowlands_pact = 1 }
            }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion add = -5 }
        }
        clamp_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion min = 0 max = 100 }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_weu_cohesion >= 75 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_league_level value = 3 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_weu_cohesion >= 45 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_league_level value = 2 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_weu_cohesion >= 20 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_league_level value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_league_level value = 0 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_league_level value = 0 }
    }
    oe_weu_sync_league_pressure = yes
}

# Country scope (Roman host). Sync embargo & coalition defense modifiers cleanly according to global_var:oe_weu_league_level.
oe_weu_sync_league_pressure = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_done } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_weu_league_level_at_least_2 = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_western_embargo_mod } }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_western_embargo_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
            }
            oe_weu_refresh_league_members = yes
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_western_embargo_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_western_embargo_mod }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_weu_league_level_at_least_3 = yes }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_crusade_pressure_mod } }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_crusade_pressure_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        else = {
            if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_crusade_pressure_mod } remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_crusade_pressure_mod }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Grant coalition defense modifier to active Western European League members not peeled off by player diplomacy.
oe_weu_refresh_league_members = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            country_exists = c:FRA
            c:FRA = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } }
            NOT = { oe_weu_fra_pact_active = yes }
        }
        c:FRA = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:HAB c:HAB = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
        c:HAB = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:SPA c:SPA = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
        c:SPA = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CAS c:CAS = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
        c:CAS = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:POR c:POR = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
        c:POR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_eng_treaty } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_eng_treaty = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:GBR c:GBR = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
            c:GBR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:ENG c:ENG = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
            c:ENG = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_lowlands_pact } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_lowlands_pact = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:NED c:NED = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
            c:NED = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:HOL c:HOL = { is_rebel_country = no NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } } }
            c:HOL = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod years = 10 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
}

# Country scope (Roman host). Apply Holy League hostility bias across active Western European powers.
oe_weu_apply_league_hostility = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HAB c:HAB = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:HAB = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_weu_b_holy_league_hostile target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SPA c:SPA = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:SPA = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_weu_b_holy_league_hostile target = root } } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CAS c:CAS = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:CAS = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_weu_b_holy_league_hostile target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POR c:POR = { is_rebel_country = no } } c:POR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_weu_b_holy_league_hostile target = root } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FRA c:FRA = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { oe_weu_fra_pact_active = yes } } c:FRA = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_weu_b_holy_league_hostile target = root } } }
}

# Country scope (Roman host). Sign Twin-Eagle & Lily Secret Accord with France (peels FRA out of Holy League).
oe_weu_sign_franco_accord = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fra_pact value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_weu_dec_fra_done value = 1 }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_lily_accord_mod years = 35 mode = replace }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:FRA c:FRA = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_weu_b_lily_accord target = c:FRA }
        c:FRA = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_weu_b_lily_accord target = root }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_lily_accord_mod years = 35 mode = replace }
        }
    }
}

}

# Country scope (Roman host). Enact Western Ecumenical Detente (read-only cross-line bonus from oe_ecc_ / oe_ar_).
oe_weu_enact_ecumenical_detente = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_rel_detente value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_weu_dec_rel_done value = 1 }
    add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_penalty }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_weu_ecc_bridge_ready = yes }
        add_stability = 4
        add_prestige = 8
    }
    else = {
        add_stability = -2
    }
    oe_weu_soften_league_opinion = yes
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_ecumenical_detente_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
}

# Country scope (Roman host). Execute Mediterranean Trade Counter-Offensive (clears Cape diversion & levies Suez dues).
oe_weu_launch_med_counter = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_med_counter value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_weu_dec_cnt_done value = 1 }
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_diversion
    add_gold = 350
    add_prestige = 15
    add_navy_tradition = 10
    if = {
        limit = { owns = location:alexandria }
        location:alexandria = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc years = 40 mode = replace } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { owns = location:constantinople }
        location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc years = 40 mode = replace } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = capital }
        capital = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc years = 40 mode = replace } }
    }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_suez_transit_boom years = 40 mode = replace }
}

}

# Country scope. Bind resolved host cleanly.
oe_weu_bind_host = {
    save_scope_as = oe_weu_tmp_host
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_host value = scope:oe_weu_tmp_host }
}

# Any scope. Resolve live Eastern Roman host (c:ROM preferred, else c:BYZ, both non-rebel).
oe_weu_resolve_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:ROM = { oe_weu_bind_host = yes }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        c:BYZ = { oe_weu_bind_host = yes }
    }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization (post-1450).
oe_weu_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_league_level value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion value = 0 }
    oe_weu_resolve_host = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_weu_has_live_host = yes }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_on value = 1 }
        global_var:oe_weu_host = { oe_weu_recalc_league = yes }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_end value = 8 }
    }
}

# Country scope (resolved Roman host). Expire closed windows & dispatch at most one event per calendar month.
oe_weu_dispatch_events = {
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1580 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_1 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_1 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1610 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_2 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_2 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1630 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_3 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_3 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1750 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_4 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_4 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1660 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_5 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_5 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1685 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_6 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_6 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1695 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_7 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_7 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1705 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_8 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_8 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1720 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_9 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_9 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1745 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_10 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_10 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1745 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_11 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_11 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_11 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_11 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1750 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_12 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_12 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fired_12 } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fired_12 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_12 value = 2 } }
    if = {
        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_ev_m = global_var:oe_weu_m } } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_weu_open_4 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_4 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_ev_m value = global_var:oe_weu_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu.4
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_weu_open_1 = yes }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_fired_1 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_ev_m value = global_var:oe_weu_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu.1
        }
        else_if = {

            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_sent_cnt add = 1 } }

# Public monthly entry point (scheduler slot 61 AND oe_weu_pulse.txt fallback).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_weu_ran_m.
oe_weu_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_m value = oe_weu_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_done }
            OR = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_on current_year >= 1450 }
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_ran_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_ran_m = global_var:oe_weu_m } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_ran_m value = global_var:oe_weu_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_init } }
            oe_weu_init_line = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_global_variable = oe_weu_end
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_end } global_var:oe_weu_end = 8 }
                current_year <= 1755
            }
            oe_weu_resolve_host = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_weu_has_live_host = yes }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_end value = 0 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_on value = 1 }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1755 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_end value = 3 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_done value = 2 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_weu_on
            }
            else = {
                # Re-bind seamlessly if ROM was formed mid-line or host changed.
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { oe_weu_has_live_host = yes }
                            AND = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_host = c:ROM } }
                        }
                    }
                    oe_weu_resolve_host = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_weu_has_live_host = yes }
                    global_var:oe_weu_host = {
                        # Immediate Lily Pact rupture watch whenever Gaul is touched
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                oe_weu_fra_pact_active = yes
                                oe_weu_touches_gaul = yes
                                trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_fra_ruptured } NOT = { global_var:oe_weu_fra_ruptured = 1 } }
                            }
                            oe_weu_execute_fra_rupture = yes
                        }
                        oe_weu_recalc_league = yes
                        oe_weu_dispatch_events = yes
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_end value = 8 }
                    remove_global_variable = oe_weu_on
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_diplomatic_wedge_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
        oe_weu_recalc_league = yes

    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_med_corsair_check_mod
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_lowlands_arbitrage_mod
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_imperial_customs_wall
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_ecumenical_detente_mod
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_orthodox_bulwark_mod
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_silver_shock_mod
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_nomisma_stabilization_mod
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_suez_transit_boom
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_grand_armada_defense
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_two_seas_concert
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_mare_nostrum_hegemon
    remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_tordesillas_boom
    location:alexandria = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    location:constantinople = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    location:milano = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    location:rome = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    location:naples = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    location:venice = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    location:genoa = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = capital }
        capital = { remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_suez_customs_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_alpine_fort_loc remove_location_modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_entrepot_loc }
    }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:FRA } c:FRA = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_lily_accord_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_gallic_mobilization } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HAB } c:HAB = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_habsburg_containment_mod } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SPA } c:SPA = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_habsburg_containment_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_tordesillas_boom } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CAS } c:CAS = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_habsburg_containment_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_tordesillas_boom } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:POR } c:POR = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_tordesillas_boom } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GBR } c:GBR = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_anglo_maritime_mod } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ENG } c:ENG = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_anglo_maritime_mod } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:NED } c:NED = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:HOL } c:HOL = { remove_country_modifier = oe_weu_league_member_mod } }
}

oe_weu_test_start = {
    oe_weu_test_clear = yes
    oe_weu_bind_host = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_m value = oe_weu_m_now }
    oe_weu_recalc_league = yes
}

oe_weu_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_weu_ran_m
    oe_weu_monthly = yes
}

oe_weu_test_league = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_on } } oe_weu_test_start = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_cohesion value = 80 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_league_level value = 3 }
    oe_weu_sync_league_pressure = yes
}

oe_weu_test_fracture = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_on } } oe_weu_test_start = yes }
    oe_weu_sign_franco_accord = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu.4
}

oe_weu_test_atl = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu_on } } oe_weu_test_start = yes }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu_diversion_seen value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_red_canal_stage value = 3 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_holder } } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_holder value = 1 } }
    add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu_atlantic_diversion years = 40 mode = replace }
}
